Debit Note

Footer templates allow you to add standard text at the bottom of your debit notes to suppliers.

Create different footer templates for various situations where you need to charge suppliers or adjust their account balances.

Name
Name

Footer templates are text blocks that appear at the bottom of debit notes, providing important information about additional charges or adjustments to your supplier's account.

Common Uses

Use footers to explain the reason for the debit, such as late delivery penalties, quality claim adjustments, damaged goods charges, or administrative fees.

Include references to your original purchase orders, dispute procedures, or payment adjustment terms to ensure clear communication with suppliers.

Creating Footer Templates

Give each footer template a descriptive name that clearly identifies its purpose. For example: 'Late Delivery Charges', 'Quality Claim Adjustments', or 'Restocking Fee'.

When creating a debit note, you can select the appropriate footer template from a dropdown list. This saves time and ensures consistency in your communications.
